sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Secrets of Polikhim is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. You couldn't have shown up at a better time. I went through my list of contacts, and you're the best person for this job. Word reached me through my usual channels that someone found a rare ultrasonic thickness gauge at the customs territory, along with several other valuable pieces of equipment. You know how things are these days - opportunities like that can't be wasted. I need you to head to Customs, recover everything of value, and move it to Polikhim, where my people are waiting. One more thing. Back in peacetime, when I worked at Polikhim, we had a shortcut... Mostly for moving equipment onto the factory grounds that would've otherwise sat in customs for months. An old mushroom picker showed it to me years ago. See if you can find and use it. It may come in handy in the future."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the precision tools package in the laboratory on Customs
- Use the transit from Customs to Factory (In one raid)
- Stash the package at the laboratory storage room on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Metal spare parts
- Unlocks purchase of 5.7x28mm R37.F at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of AK GP-25 accessory kit recoil pad at Prapor LL2
"Everything's been moved? Excellent work."

sections.heading: Customs Tools location
sections.text: In the laboratory building. There are multiple spawns on the second floor.

sections.heading: Customs to Factory
sections.text: Next to the Old Gas Station extraction. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

sections.heading: Factory Stashing location
sections.text: In the storage room below the laboratory.
